name: ruby
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: HELLSCRIPT dark fantasy action RPG inventory gemstone icon, first in a consistent set of six.
Primary request: Paint ONE isolated deep crimson ruby gemstone (G01, Korean name 홍옥). Rounded octagonal cushion cut with broad readable polygon facets, rich garnet-red body, restrained warm scarlet inner reflections, crisp small pale highlights from the upper left. A substantial believable jewel, hand-painted premium RPG item art, subtly worn yet carefully polished, restrained realism, high contrast facets readable at 48 pixels. Not pixel art, not a photoreal studio product photograph, not glossy toy art.
Composition: square 1024 by 1024 canvas, gemstone perfectly centered, modest 3/4 top view, entire gem visible, occupying about 74 percent of canvas width and height, clean consistent margin. One jewel only, no smaller shards or companion objects.
Output: transparent PNG with genuine preserved RGBA alpha. ALL surrounding and internal empty space must be fully transparent. Native transparency is required. No scenery, no solid backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no frame, no socket, no mounting, no shadow outside the silhouette, no glow or particles outside the silhouette. No text, labels, letters, numerals, watermark, skull or bone motif. Preserve crisp clean alpha edges without white or dark matte fringe.
